projection.note: Same as scripts/build-tiles.mjs: flat (equirectangular) projection, metres per degree taken at the origin. x = east, z = SOUTH (north is −z); 1 unit = 1 m.

meta.lengths: lengthKm values: great-circle length of the full-resolution OSM geometry. inBoxKm: length inside mapBox after clipping in game coordinates. Polylines are simplified (Douglas–Peucker) to the tolerance below; latlon and xz hold the same points.
meta.inferred: Fields named "inferred*", values starting "inferred:", nearTracks, interchanges, nearbyRailStations and levelFromTrack are derived by distance, name or geometry, not tagged in OSM.
